description: Ambiguity-pattern taxonomy shared by Phase 0 (simulation attribution), Phase 1 (detector rules) and later phases. Severity: 1=low, 2=medium, 3=high. safe_default_possible=false means the gap usually needs a user answer rather than a labeled assumption.

patterns.description: No language/framework/runtime stated for the build.
patterns.example_trigger: make me a tinder clone but for books

patterns.description: Target platform unstated (web / mobile / desktop / CLI / extension).
Subjective or open-ended qualifiers that set no testable bar (nice, clean, modern, simple, flexible, 'and stuff').
Core entities and their fields unstated; the agent must invent the data model.
Multiple loosely-related features bundled in one sentence with no prioritization.
patterns.example_trigger: track workouts and progress, with social features

patterns.description: No definition of done / acceptance criteria; 'finished' is unverifiable.
User accounts / multi-user / permissions unaddressed though the app implies users.
External service referenced without provider, protocol or flow (payments, email integration, login).
